finding: The generic response parser rejects untagged BYE before the matching tagged completion, including normal LOGOUT. Existing callers generally ignore the cleanup error and drop the transport.

standardReferences.requirement: For client-requested logout, read the tagged OK before closing the connection.
LOGOUT normally receives untagged BYE followed by tagged OK.
The modern reference retains the same client completion rule; this does not claim full IMAP4rev2 support.

repairScope: Accept and drain BYE only for exact case-insensitive LOGOUT, through bounded matching completion; keep BYE fatal for other commands and retain failure on EOF or wrong tags.
sensitivity: The valid fragmented BYE with trailing literal-looking text then tagged OK fails on the original parser.
